estimates.assumptions: 320g ready-to-use puff pastry (standard all-butter type); values based on typical commercial product nutrition per gram.
4 tbsp (≈60g) dark brown soft sugar; fully contributes its sugar calories.
3 medium Braeburn apples (≈540g total raw edible weight after peeling/coring); modest size assumed, raw values used.
4 tbsp (≈80g) of the prepared red wine jelly from the instructions (wine + jam sugar reduced); modest sugar content assumed for syrupy jelly.
100ml crème fraîche (standard ~30-35% fat product); volume converted at typical density.
1 tbsp (≈8g) icing sugar; fully contributes its sugar calories.
3 whole cardamom pods (≈2g total, ground for mixing); modest spice weight, typical per-pod values.
